team: Deload week, both trained Monday, Tuesday and hockey with zero knee pain. Fred did all 5 planned sessions for the first time and cut his sim from 33:52 to 32:25; Will logged Monday and Friday as rest days and has no sim yet, but ran the most even intervals of the two.

fred.headline: First 5 of 5, sim 87 s faster
fred.summary: All five planned sessions done (Monday on Tuesday, Tuesday on Wednesday), knee pain 0 all week and average RPE 7.0 vs 6.8 last week. Run km is 6.4 of the 6.4 km core target, with the Sunday zone 2 run still to come. The sim dropped from 33:52 to 32:25, but at RPE 9 for a 75% session, and you wrote that the engine gave up after a hard first run and SkiErg.
strengths: Sim 32:25 vs 33:52 on the same format: runs 1:44 faster in total, burpee broad jumps 2:29 to 2:19, SkiErg 2:15 to 2:12.
Tuesday done this time: 4 x 600 m plus all of arms block A, so the run streak is back.
Deload taken properly: trap bar 185 and hack squat 135 at RIR 3+, EMOM 12 min done in 12:00 on both days, and the new Friday curls all logged.
weaknesses: Sim runs went 5:22, 5:58, 6:20, 6:44: an 82 s spread (target 10 to 15 s). Run 1 was 31 s faster than 1:25 goal pace (5:53), and you paid for it later.
Sleds slowed at the same weight: push 1:10 to 1:20, pull 1:47 to 2:07 even after the 15 s lap correction.
Hammer curls 3 x 8 and incline curls 7 to 8 reps are below the planned rep ranges, so those loads hold for now.
tips: Pacing is your cheapest win. Next Saturday open the first 1 km at 6:00 to 6:05 and keep all four within 15 s of each other. Even splits would have beaten today's time.
For the engine: do tomorrow's Sunday run truly at 130 to 140 bpm, and run Tuesday's 4 x 1 km at the same pace on every rep. Aerobic base fixes the fade, hard first kms do not.

Weekly body weight average went 160.9 to 159.0 lb in the first week of your cut, faster than the 1 lb a week you aimed for. One week is mostly water, so keep both weigh-ins and judge it on next week's average.

tweaks.text: Trap bar 3 x 5 at 235 lb and stop each set at 5 reps; hack squat stays at 170 lb because last time your note said 160 and the Loads line said 170, so log the top set exactly.
DB bench 60 lb for 3 x 8; if a set drops under 6 reps, finish at 55 lb.

will.headline: Even runs, Friday and sim missing
will.summary: Three of five planned sessions so far: Monday (done Tuesday), Tuesday and hockey; Monday and Friday were logged as rest days and the sim is not logged yet. Knee pain was 0 all week, down from 3 last week, and average RPE fell from 7.3 to 5.3. Run km is 2.4 of the 6.4 km core target without the sim.
strengths: Best intervals on the team: 600 m reps 3:26, 3:27, 3:22, 3:21, about 5:40 per km and getting faster.
Monday EMOM was 20+ on sled push 190 lb, lunges 44 lb and farmers 53 lb, so you have room to go up.
Knee pain 0 on every log this week, and your first Thursday weigh-in is in.
weaknesses: No Friday session for the second week running, and three of the last four Fridays missed or partial.
No sim this week yet, so no splits to compare with last week's estimated 35:22.
Triceps 60 lb at RIR 0 again, the third week in a row at RIR 0 on arms.
tips: Friday is your missing piece. If time is short, do pull ups, DB bench and the EMOM and skip arms block B rather than skipping the day.
If you do the sim tomorrow, tap the big bottom button after every run and station. Your run pacing looks good, now we need real splits.
Arms: keep laterals at 15 lb, curls at 22.5 lb and triceps at 60 lb, and stop each set with 1 to 2 reps left before adding weight. Body weight is stable, about 186 lb this week vs 185.4 in week 1.

tweaks.text: EMOM was 20+ on every move: sled push 210 lb and farmers carry 60 lb per hand (the plan goes above race weight this week), lunges stay at 44 lb.
Book Friday in now: pull ups, DB bench 50 lb for 3 x 8 and the 16 min EMOM are the minimum.
